tips.text: Pop every Atramentum Balloon once Follie starts hunting; a loot radar mod shows the ones in your room.
Run solo, on Steel Path if you can survive it; solo needs only 2 Paint per canvas.
Fill canvas B before 50% progress; after that Drip, Drip, Drip walls off routes.
Set up your Operator for speed and staying upright, with Unairu, Magus Cadence, Metem-Erun and Talsek-An, not Void Sling.
Bring a no-energy or tanky frame like Hildryn, Lavos, Wisp, Inaros, Dante, Rhino or Kullervo.
Pop balloons with Hikou plus Concealed Explosives, or let an Oxylus with Scan Matter do it.
Remember enemy-dropped Atramentum is not shared with the squad; balloon Atramentum is.
Finish runs instead of camping for enemy drops; an hour of camping lost to simply clearing.
Plan on the Atramentum shop from the first run; the drop table is 5% per item and mostly junk.
Do a few runs a day instead of marathoning; players call Follie's Hunt one of the most boring farms.
The 2,400 Atramentum shop makes this one of the more predictable farms, at about 30 good Steel Path runs worst case.
